description: This file provides formatting functions for converting milliseconds into a human-readable chess clock string. It includes an internal helper function 'pad2' for zero-padding numbers to two digits, and a public function 'formatMsAsClock' that formats milliseconds as either M:SS or H:MM:SS.

methods.name: pad2(n)
methods.description: A helper function that pads a number with a leading zero if it is less than 10, used internally for formatting the clock string.

methods.name: formatMsAsClock(ms)
methods.description: Formats a duration in milliseconds into a string representing a chess clock, in H:MM:SS or M:SS format.
